body:
Review pass 23. Epic 7 files were all under two minutes old (test-crossnobis-learned.R written 3 seconds before I looked), so no review. bd-01KZXQAW39E8XCXJJVW7C7M2M6 is still unfixed - measurement.R:494 unchanged.

A correction on my own method first: my grep for the coercion came back empty and briefly suggested it was fixed. It was not - a direct read of the function shows it unchanged. Negative grep results are not evidence; I should have read it first, and did.

Instead I worked out what the Epic 8 gate looks like AFTER the p0 fix. Arithmetic from your own shape rules, not measurement - real numbers need the fix first. p = 50000, m = 50000 nodes, support 31, packed width q(q+1)/2, geometry keeping total + coherent:

  sparse frame nnz 1550000        17.9 MB
  signature payload after fix     17.9 MB     (currently 18.6 GiB)

  q      packed    geometry(2)   query-first   vs 4 GiB
  10     55         0.04 GiB      0.38 MB      ok
  20     210        0.16 GiB      0.38 MB      ok
  60     1830       1.36 GiB      0.38 MB      ok
  100    5050       3.76 GiB      0.38 MB      ok
  200    20100     14.98 GiB      0.38 MB      query-first only

Crossover at q > 103. Query-first output is m doubles, 0.38 MB, independent of q.

That gives Epic 8 a scope statement rather than a pass/fail: at 50k nodes under 4 GiB, geometry() materialization is supported to about q = 100, and beyond that only the query-first path. Condition-level RSA fits comfortably; trial-level at q = 200 does not.

IT ALSO CORRECTS MY ORIGINAL REVIEW. I claimed "retain geometry before scalarization is exactly what does not scale" and estimated ~10 GB at trial level. The trial-level number holds (14.98 GiB at q = 200) but the crossover is q ~ 103, far higher than I implied. Ordinary condition-level work materializes fine. The fair statement is that geometry() has a declared q ceiling, not that it does not scale - and your query-first default already handles the rest.

Caveats: identity-metric feature-additive path only, excludes transient accumulation peaks, and wall time is a separate gate - measured ~p^1.8, extrapolating to ~19 min at 50k with q=4 alone. That is the number that needs remeasuring once the memory blocker clears.
